rows.summary: Cicero, Kierkegaard, and Aristotle completed the v5 x1 app-server notifier run.
Arby and Aster Vale were polled through a five-window watcher check and still have no final-message files.
Thirty-two current searches and twenty-five source URLs were recorded.
Command and skill metadata were converted into a capability graph without mutation.
Ninety proposals were classified into safe probe tiers; no installs were claimed.
All six GMUT gates remain open.
